description: bosaiXview (Bosai Cross View) is the disaster information service of the Japanese National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience. It gathers the information needed for disaster response that is shared through SIP4D, the basic disaster information distribution network, and publishes it together as map portfolios for each event. Recent portfolios listed on the NIED home page cover the August 2026 Chiba heavy rain and Typhoon No. 25 of 2026 (published 25 September 2026), the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake, and several earthquakes in 2026 off Iwate, Sanriku and eastern Yamanashi. The same page links real-time hazard information maps, the NIED institutional repository of papers and disaster survey reports, and the MOWLAS land and sea observation network for earthquakes, tsunamis and volcanoes. The map portfolios are free to view online as ArcGIS web applications; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the pages are in Japanese, the home page needs JavaScript for full use, and the layers come from many agencies with different update times. Coverage is Japan. It supports emergency response and hazard exposure analysis for infrastructure during floods, typhoons and earthquakes; the related record is the Italian Civil Protection maps and dashboards.
